description: Create an email template for mailing from a form. Put a field's 'html_name' into body and subject WITHOUT any brackets (just as text, for example: Hello, Full Name). Never use {{}} or []. Get html_name through get_form_fields.

email_column_id.description: Name or ID of the field with the recipient's email (note: NOT html_name, but the name or id itself)

recipient_source.description: 0 = the given addresses, 1 = from a field of the form

subject.description: Email subject (use the fields' html_name without brackets)

name: create_email_template
